topics.title: Compliance and Responsiveness
topics.description: The package must address mandatory requirements, submission instructions, and stated evaluation criteria without contradiction or omission.
checks: Every mandatory requirement is mapped to a proposal section or completed form.
Submission path, due date, due time, and mandatory meeting requirements are confirmed.
No unsupported promises appear in the client-facing draft.

topics.title: Content Plan and Section Ownership
topics.description: The proposal organization, section briefs, and section ownership need to be established before drafting.
checks: Every draft section has a defined objective and supporting requirements.
Every scorable topic has a named owner role and expected artifacts.

topics.title: Executive Summary Discipline
topics.description: The opening narrative should focus on buyer priorities, discriminators, and confidence in execution.
checks: The executive summary reflects buyer priorities and win themes.
The executive summary avoids internal process language.

topics.title: Gate Decisions, Reviews, and Schedule
topics.description: The package run should reflect formal review gates and production readiness checkpoints.
checks: Pink, red, and gold review outputs are recorded.
Pricing approval and export approval are explicit human gates.

topics.title: Page and Document Design Readiness
topics.description: The export should be production-friendly and easy for the proposal team to finish in Word.
checks: The DOCX uses business-appropriate titles and headings.
The appendix and attachment set are organized for production.
